$meta.name: AISHA brand design tokens
$meta.sourceOfTruth: aisha-guru-web/lib/tokens.src.css (private brand repo, linked as the domains/templates/aisha.guru submodule)
$meta.note: This file is the committed in-stack mirror of the canonical brand for the INTERNAL surfaces (cockpit, workbench admin). The marketing web is operator-self-branded per AISHA_SEED_DOMAIN and does NOT use this. Regenerate consumers via `npm run gen:tokens`. A drift gate keeps this in sync with the canonical source when the submodule is present.
$meta.mobileNote: The `mobile` section below is AISHA's brand for the mobile app — the DEFAULT, not a constraint. The mobile app is a CLIENT-FACING white-label product: a client builds it under its own store identity from its own brand file of this same shape (`--brand <file>`), and the app is never forked to do it. Nothing may pin the mobile surface to the values below.

$fontNote: Brand typeface for the PUBLIC/OSS stack is Nunito Sans (SIL OFL) — it replaced commercial Avenir (PR #298) per the OSS-only rule. The canonical aisha-guru-web brand repo still declares Avenir for private instances; this is an intentional public/private divergence. The drift gate checks colours + skew (which match canonical), not fonts. Nunito Sans is a single weight-axis variable family (400-800), so the weight roles below all resolve to it.

font.mono: ui-monospace, "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

mobile.$note: Mobile surface theme. The shape (colors/spacing/typography) is the contract mobile-app/src/theme/index.ts exposes to ~37 call sites; the values here are the brand. An instance brand file overrides these — see build.mjs --brand.

typography.$note: Role písma pro mobil. NAMĚŘENO 2026-09-02 proti maketě „řidič v2 · Páska dne": hierarchii tam nedělá velký nadpis (hero má 26 px, naše h1 28 px — strop sedí), ale MALÝ POPISEK vedle něj: maketa jde na 9–10 px, kdežto naše podlaha byla 12 px. Proto přibyly `micro`/`nano`, ne větší nadpisy. `ghost` je orientační číslo jízdy (84 px, kreslí se potlačeně). `font` odkazuje na roli z kořenového `font` — bez ní se čísla, časy a kódy sázejí jako věta a nečtou se jako údaj.
